In automatic morphological inflection, we assume access to a gold-standard dataset D train with triples of ⟨X, Y, T⟩, where X is the character sequence of the lemma, T is a morphosyntactic description (MSD), and Y is the character sequence of the inflected form. The goal is then to learn the distribution P (Y|X, T) over inflected forms conditioned on a lemma and MSD.
outputs: inflected forms (character sequences) generated from lemmas and morphosyntactic descriptions.
